FIND: `MacrophageCell.observe` records `summary.anomaly_count = len(summary.anomalies)` into `_round_history`. If `_self_check_observe` triggers a `persistent_anomaly` because the last 3 rounds had anomalies, this `persistent_anomaly` itself counts as an anomaly. This guarantees the current round has `anomaly_count >= 1`. Consequently, the next round will also see the last 3 rounds having anomalies, triggering another `persistent_anomaly`.
FOLLOW: The system enters an inescapable infinite loop of anomalies. Once 3 consecutive rounds have anomalies, every subsequent round will generate a `persistent_anomaly` alert, permanently flooding the HIL audit log and masking real pipeline recovery.
ANALYSE: HARD constraint (logic/correctness). A self-referential monitor must not let its own meta-alerts sustain the condition it is monitoring. Premises: 1) `persistent_anomaly` is added to `summary.observations` with `is_anomaly=True`. 2) `summary.anomaly_count` counts all `is_anomaly=True`. 3) `_round_history` stores this count. 4) `_self_check_observe` checks if the last 3 rounds in `_round_history` have `anomaly_count > 0`. Conclusion: A single `persistent_anomaly` ensures the next round will also see a history of anomalies, creating a self-sustaining loop. CONFIRMED.

FIND: In `_patrol_observe`, `vstr = getattr(v, "verdict", str(v))` extracts the verdict attribute directly. If `v.verdict` is an Enum (which is standard for `CellVerdict`), `vstr` becomes an Enum object. This Enum is then stored in `evidence={"verdict_type": verdict_type}`. When `MacrophageObservation.to_dict()` is called, it stringifies floats but leaves Enums untouched. Downstream, `VerificationChain` will crash with `TypeError: Object of type ... is not JSON serializable` when calling `json.dumps()`.
FOLLOW: The entire pipeline crashes during the `sign_observation` step because the `VerificationChain` requires canonical JSON serialization for cryptographic hashing.
ANALYSE: HARD constraint (interface/correctness). `to_dict` must return a JSON-serializable dictionary as per its docstring contract. Premises: 1) `CellVerdict.verdict` is typically an Enum. 2) `getattr(v, "verdict", str(v))` returns the Enum. 3) `evidence` stores this Enum. 4) `to_dict` does not stringify Enums. 5) `json.dumps` cannot serialize Enums. Conclusion: The pipeline will crash when attempting to sign an observation containing an Enum verdict. CONFIRMED.
FIX:
